correctness.rationale: The explicitly inspected nine-state generator has all allowed entry, active hop, exit, and per-particle switching transitions. For the tilted exit matrix C, stationary pi and unique mean-zero Poisson solution h give J=1^T C pi and F=1+2(1^T C h)/J; this is standard perturbation of a finite irreducible generator. The supplied rational polynomials A(p,q) and P(p,q)>0 define F=A/P^2, and current J is explicitly rational. Reconstructed full verification code builds Q,C and checks exact positivity/negativity of differentiated polynomial coefficients: ∂p J<0, ∂q F<0. The degree-14 numerator for ∂pF has signs + at p^0 through p^2, - at p^14; each coefficient p^3 through p^13 has one positive q-zero in explicitly disjoint increasing rational brackets. Therefore for every q the p coefficients have one sign transition, giving one and only one positive critical point by Descartes plus endpoint signs. The Sturm count at q=0.33646 with an exact positive witness at q=0.33645 yields unique super-Poisson threshold via strict ∂qF<0. Symbolic p=qt and p=q²t limits and derivative-sign trapping give p*~tau q and p*~4q². The paper reports 16 numerical tilted-eigenvalue checks but the universal proof is exact algebra. The inspected script, not its claimed PASS log, shows the substantive certificates; finite samples alone are not the proof.
